about: Absolute refractive indices measured over temperature with the Cryogenic High-Accuracy Refraction Measuring System (CHARMS) at NASA Goddard, as the published three-term Sellmeier models whose strengths S_i and wavelengths lambda_i (um) are 4th-order polynomials in the temperature in kelvin: n^2 - 1 = sum S_i(T) lambda^2 / (lambda^2 - lambda_i(T)^2), S_i(T) = sum_j S_ij T^j. Coefficients are listed constant term first.
